summary: rollcall ship: after a merge it waits only for the deployments the merge started and the default branch's required checks (release.waitFor), naming other runs instead of failing on them; new `rollcall ship workflow` dispatches and watches a workflow, and `rollcall usage report` times each ship phase before the first push.
why: A slow post-merge suite outlived the 30-minute wait, so every such ship ended failed and woke a model for nothing.
